about: Ratcheted pass-rate floors of the oracle scorecard (test/fidelity/oracle-report.test.ts and test/browser/oracle-scorecard.test.ts): per sample with an oracle SVG in graph-io/test/fidelity/oracles/ (and <sample>@matched, the comparison with graphty's nodes at the program's own positions), per property of test/fidelity/oracle/compare-oracle.ts and per raster region (raster.<region>, 2 places). Stand-in oracles (another program's drawing, or a raster) keep their floors in standInFloors. Recording keeps the higher of the stored and the measured rate, so a floor is never lowered by a run; a floor lowered by hand is listed in lowered with why. An allowed drop is "<sample>/<property>": { reason, issue: "#N" or "ISSUES.md <row>", expires: "YYYY-MM-DD", atLeast }, and fails the run once expired or under atLeast. The elements known to fail each property are in oracle-known-failures.json.
